study type: Prospective observational study with pre-post intervention design
outcome: Intraventricular pressure difference (IVPD) in the left ventricle (LV)
cohort: The study included 28 monochorionic diamniotic (MD) twins diagnosed with twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS) who underwent fetoscopic laser photocoagulation.
finding: After fetoscopic laser photocoagulation, significant increases in total and mid-apical intraventricular pressure difference were noted in the left ventricle of recipient twins, and all intraventricular pressure differences (total, basal, and mid-apical) were significantly increased in the left ventricle of donor twins.
cross-section timing: Before and after fetoscopic laser photocoagulation
